=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:277-296 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: For self-repo callers, the gate's compound condition reduces to "ref must match refs/heads/main or refs/tags/stable" because the trusted_consumer_pin branch is short-circuited by `[ "${CALLER_REPOSITORY}" = "shubhodeep1/coding-workflows" ]`. Direct `pull_request` triggers on the source repository set workflow_ref to the PR branch ref (e.g. `refs/heads/ai/issue-4399`), which neither clause matches, so the gate rejects the run.
  WHY: The cited CI log shows `workflow_ref: "shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml@refs/heads/ai/issue-4399"`, the gate emits `::error::Review support must resolve to an approved workflow ref and immutable commit SHA.`, and exits 1 before any downstream review jobs run. The gate therefore blocks every legitimate `pull_request`-triggered review on the source repository.
